topic: the evolution v2 capability map: what the jev decision model's full surface adds over evolution v1, paper-derived loop primitives (null-standardized claims, standard candles, exclusion-only verdicts), and the reassessed worker module map

subtopics.scope: What the jev-1.13 decision model's full typed surface (noul, score 0-9, choice, confidence routing, session grouping, consumed cost tracking) adds over evolution v1's implicit prose-only use.
seed_queries: calibrated decision model LLM yes no probability API triage
LLM output confidence routing threshold forced escalation design

subtopics.scope: Paper-derived gating invariants for a self-improvement loop: single-action atom with d_pre/d_post/delta and a stay option, delta >= 0 as bug alarm, cumulative monotonicity vs per-cycle increments, and the identity/measurement boundary that keeps machine-checkable identities out of the human gate.
seed_queries: telescoping sum monotonicity invariant software loop design
identity assertions versus measurements verification boundary testing

subtopics.scope: The PC1+PC2 >= 0.40 concentration gate: any principal-component fit used for scoring must clear the explained-variance floor or it is not used, plus the atomicity diagnostic that checks the measurement basis carries information before derived scores are trusted.
seed_queries: PCA explained variance ratio threshold first two components quality
principal component analysis explained variance criteria dimensionality reduction

subtopics.scope: Null-standardized improvement claims: no effect reported raw, z against a matched null (label-permutation / null-delivery ensembles), and exclusion-only verdicts (excluded / not-excluded / not-tested) emitted at |z| > 3 instead of narratives.
seed_queries: permutation test null distribution standardized effect size z score
label permutation test null ensemble hypothesis testing

subtopics.scope: Round-trip validation and the standard candle: periodically planting a known-outcome directive the loop must detect, measuring detection power, catching approve-nothing and approve-everything loops, plus selection-null discipline when the loop tunes its own thresholds.
seed_queries: standard candle astronomy calibration luminosity reference
canary planted known outcome detection system validation power

subtopics.scope: Reporting and audit instruments: the dBc level scale (20 log10 of delta over null sigma) for cross-cycle comparability, the anti-caustic guard on exact 1.0000 passes, fixpoint termination when peak delta falls below epsilon, and the dynamics audit over the append-only event log (f_back, absorbing states, flip rate).
seed_queries: decibel logarithmic ratio measurement scale signal noise
absorbing state markov chain flip rate transition analysis

subtopics.scope: The corpus audit lens: per-artifact coverage vectors placed on a sphere, sparse cells driving the next proposals (llc App B), and point-map memory-layer discipline: frozen frames, identity keys, rule_hash, changed-vs-silent names, named-neighbour ledger, matched-null placement.
seed_queries: coverage matrix sparse cells gap analysis prioritization
embedding store deduplication content hash identity keys

subtopics.scope: The reassessed evolution v2 module map (A trigger + machine-cycle, B atom ledger + calibration, C memory + recall, D execution + notify, E preflight + verify, F jev quality assessment), the Cloudflare surface it maps onto (Cron restore, Queues, Vectorize, D1, R2 and DO non-goals), and the lane plan.
seed_queries: cloudflare workers cron triggers queues durable objects vectorize overview
cloudflare d1 durable objects compare state storage
